profiles.dialog_description: Each person on this device keeps their own charts. No accounts, no passwords — everything stays on this device.
profiles.empty_state: No people yet — add one below.
profiles.last_person_hint: At least one person must remain
profiles.delete_confirm: Delete {{name}} and their charts? This cannot be undone.
profiles.delete_error: Couldn't finish deleting this person. Nothing was removed — please try again.
profiles.add_error: Couldn't save this person on this device. Try again, or close this window and they won't be kept.

storage_blocked.title: AlmaMesh can't run until this browser lets it save data
storage_blocked.body: AlmaMesh needs permission to store data on this device so SQLite can save your chart. Until you allow it, AlmaMesh (including Import and Export) can't run.
storage_blocked.reassure: Allowing it only lets AlmaMesh keep your data here, on this device.
storage_blocked.no_settings_link: A web page can't open your browser's settings, so this part is up to you. It takes about a minute.

safari_macos.open: In the menu bar, choose Safari → Settings.
safari_macos.back: Come back to this tab and press Check again.
safari_macos.private: Use a normal window, not a Private window: AlmaMesh can't save your chart there.

safari_ios.safari: Tap Apps, then Safari. (On older iOS, Safari is listed in Settings directly.)
safari_ios.back: Come back to this tab and press Check again.
safari_ios.private: Use a normal tab, not a Private tab: AlmaMesh can't save your chart there.

chromium.open: Open Settings → Privacy and security → Site settings (in Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions).
chromium.allow: Open “On-device site data” (older versions: “Cookies and site data”) and allow almamesh.com to save data. If it is listed under “Not allowed”, remove it.
chromium.site_info: Or click the site-information icon at the left of the address bar, choose Site settings, and allow it there.
chromium.back: Come back to this tab and press Check again.
chromium.private: Use a normal window, not Incognito (Chrome) or InPrivate (Edge).

firefox.padlock: Click the padlock at the left of the address bar. If it shows a blocked permission to store data, clear it.
firefox.settings: Or open Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data → Manage Exceptions, enter almamesh.com and choose Allow.
firefox.allow: Press Allow storage below. If Firefox asks, choose Allow.
firefox.private: Use a normal window, not a Private window.

other.settings: In your browser's settings, allow almamesh.com to store site data.
other.back: Come back to this tab and press Check again.
other.private: Use a normal window, not a private one.

illustration.label: The setting should look like this: {{setting}}, {{state}}

storage_blocked.still_blocked: Still blocked. The browser is still refusing storage for this site. Follow the steps above, then press Check again.

engine_other_tab.title: AlmaMesh is open in another tab
engine_other_tab.body: Only one AlmaMesh tab can use the chart engine at a time. Close the other AlmaMesh tab, then press Try again.

storage_unavailable.title: AlmaMesh cannot start its on-device database
storage_unavailable.body: AlmaMesh computes and keeps your chart only on this device, and this browser cannot run the local database it needs.
storage_unavailable.fix: Try a current version of Safari, Chrome, Firefox or Edge in a normal (not private) window, then reload this page.

error_boundary.title: Something went wrong
error_boundary.body: We encountered an unexpected error. Please try refreshing the page.
error_boundary.reset_hint: Still stuck after an update? This clears cached data and reloads a fresh copy. Your saved charts may be cleared.
error_boundary.update_body: A new version of AlmaMesh is available. Reloading now — your saved charts stay on this device.

update.finishing_previous: Finishing the previous download… updating when it's done.
update.stalled: The update couldn't finish. Close other AlmaMesh tabs, then reload.

location.offline_hint: City name + ordinary HTTPS request metadata are sent · works offline too

coordinates.toggle: Can't find your birthplace? Enter coordinates
coordinates.hint: Enter the birthplace's latitude and longitude in decimal degrees. The timezone is resolved on your device — no network needed.
coordinates.range_error: Latitude must be between −90 and 90, and longitude between −180 and 180.

ai_badge.label: AI: {{provider}}
ai_badge.title_setup: Connect an AI model (e.g. OpenRouter) to enable interpretations

engine_rollback.warning: This server offered an older version of the engine than the one you already have. That can mean someone is tampering with it. Only clear it if you trust this site and your network.
engine_rollback.confirm_prompt: Clearing removes this device's protection against the older version. Clear anyway?

storage.interpretations_set_aside: Some saved interpretations could not be read and were set aside on this device. They are kept for 30 days and then deleted. To remove them now, use Settings → Preferences → Reset chart / start fresh.
storage.interpretations_unreadable_paused: Some saved interpretations could not be read, and this device could not set them aside. To protect them, new readings are paused. Reload the page to try again.

reset_incomplete: Reset could not delete all saved data, because this browser is still using it. Close every AlmaMesh tab and try again. If this keeps happening, clear AlmaMesh's site data in your browser settings.

dropped_writes.body: Some changes on this page weren't saved because your data was being replaced or repaired. Reload to see your current data.
dropped_writes.discard_failed_body: A person you cancelled couldn't be removed from this device, so they may come back after a reload.
